tool_args.rationale: The pilot approaches the archived supercritical threshold of 2.50–2.68, but has no observations above it. A high-gradient probe can distinguish an avalanche from smooth saturation before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches s_grad 2.44, near the archived avalanche threshold, so the ordinary and threshold mechanisms remain ambiguous.
The present ambiguity concerns high-gradient behavior, not identification of a coupled trajectory ODE.
It does not resolve the threshold ambiguity.
